# Audible

> Audible is Amazon's leading audiobook platform offering thousands of titles, exclusive Originals, and flexible subscription plans with narration by acclaimed actors and voice performers.

Audible provides a comprehensive digital audiobook experience featuring bestselling titles, full-cast productions, and exclusive content across multiple genres including fantasy, fiction, self-help, and LitRPG series. The platform serves millions of subscribers with various membership tiers and free trial options.

## Getting Started

- [Audible Homepage](https://www.audible.com): Main Audible homepage showcasing audiobooks, Originals, and subscription plans
- [Subscription Plans](https://www.audible.com/ep/plan-picker): Compare and select from Audible subscription plan options tailored to your listening needs
- [Subscription Confirmation](https://www.audible.com/subscription/confirmation): Account authentication and subscription confirmation page with Amazon Sign In integration

## Bestselling Audiobooks

- [Project Hail Mary by Andy Weir](https://www.audible.com/pd/Project-Hail-Mary-Audiobook/B08G9PRS1K): Science fiction audiobook narrated by Ray Porter, featuring a thrilling space rescue mission
- [The Let Them Theory by Mel Robbins](https://www.audible.com/pd/The-Let-Them-Theory-Audiobook/B0DFMX1RT8): Self-help audiobook narrated by author Mel Robbins on personal empowerment and mindset
- [Reminders of Him by Colleen Hoover](https://www.audible.com/pd/Reminders-of-Him-Audiobook/1713641380): Contemporary fiction audiobook exploring themes of second chances and redemption
- [My Husband's Wife by Alice Feeney](https://www.audible.com/pd/My-Husbands-Wife-Audiobook/B0F6FJCXM3): Psychological thriller audiobook narrated by Richard Armitage with multiple narrative perspectives

## Harry Potter Full-Cast Editions

- [Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone (Full-Cast Edition)](https://www.audible.com/pd/Harry-Potter-and-the-Sorcerers-Stone-Full-Cast-Edition-Audiobook/B0F14RPXHR): Full-cast audiobook featuring Hugh Laurie, Matthew Macfadyen, and ensemble cast
- [Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets (Full-Cast Edition)](https://www.audible.com/pd/Harry-Potter-and-the-Chamber-of-Secrets-Full-Cast-Edition-Audiobook/B0F154ZCSN): Full-cast production with Hugh Laurie, Kit Harington, and distinguished voice actors
- [Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban (Full-Cast Edition)](https://www.audible.com/pd/Harry-Potter-and-the-Prisoner-of-Azkaban-Full-Cast-Edition-Audiobook/B0F14PK33J): Full-cast narration featuring Hugh Laurie, Simon Pegg, and acclaimed ensemble
- [Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire (Full-Cast Edition)](https://www.audible.com/pd/Harry-Potter-and-the-Goblet-of-Fire-Full-Cast-Edition-Audiobook/B0F14PB6WN): Full-cast audiobook with Hugh Laurie, James McAvoy, and star-studded narrator lineup
- [Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix (Full-Cast Edition)](https://www.audible.com/pd/Harry-Potter-and-the-Order-of-the-Phoenix-Full-Cast-Edition-Audiobook/B0F14P2632): Full-cast production featuring Hugh Laurie, Keira Knightley, and ensemble cast

## LitRPG & Fantasy Series

- [Dungeon Crawler Carl by Matt Dinniman](https://www.audible.com/pd/Dungeon-Crawler-Carl-Audiobook/B08V8B2CGV): LitRPG audiobook narrated by Jeff Hays, first in the popular Dungeon Crawler Carl series
- [Carl's Doomsday Scenario by Matt Dinniman](https://www.audible.com/pd/Carls-Doomsday-Scenario-Audiobook/B0934GTSGT): LitRPG audiobook continuation narrated by Jeff Hays in the Dungeon Crawler Carl series
- [The Dungeon Anarchist's Cookbook by Matt Dinniman](https://www.audible.com/pd/The-Dungeon-Anarchists-Cookbook-Audiobook/B094XCNV6G): Third book in the Dungeon Crawler Carl LitRPG series with immersive fantasy worldbuilding
- [The Gate of the Feral Gods by Matt Dinniman](https://www.audible.com/pd/The-Gate-of-the-Feral-Gods-Audiobook/B09GCYRZRQ): Fourth installment of Dungeon Crawler Carl series, continuing epic fantasy adventure
- [Mark of the Fool 10 by J.M. Clarke](https://www.audible.com/pd/Mark-of-the-Fool-10-Audiobook/B0GQWJQBWT): Progression fantasy audiobook series finale featuring magical development and adventure

## Featured Fiction

- [Judge Stone by James Patterson & Viola Davis](https://www.audible.com/pd/Judge-Stone-Audiobook/B0FVWB1XP8): Legal thriller audiobook narrated by Viola Davis, combining crime drama with courtroom intrigue
- [The Correspondent by Virginia Evans](https://www.audible.com/pd/The-Correspondent-Audiobook/B0DG3SGZYN): Fiction audiobook featuring multi-narrator cast bringing literary storytelling to life
- [Theo of Golden by Allen Levi](https://www.audible.com/pd/Theo-of-Golden-Audiobook/B0FTT6KFKR): Contemporary fiction audiobook narrated by David Morse with compelling character development
